annotations.title: A2A Agent Card check: fields, signatures and cross-protocol identity

description: A2A Agent Card check: fields, signatures and cross-protocol identity. Use when an agent is about to rely on another agent's A2A Agent Card and needs its required fields checked, each JWS signature checked against the RFC 8785 canonical card with the key its jku names, and the operator names, domains and versions in the domain's MCP server card, AI Catalog and ARD manifest laid side by side. Cost: 2 credits per call.

domain.description: The domain to check (or a URL whose host is used). Its /.well-known/agent-card.json is read, then the older /.well-known/agent.json if that is missing. Send domain or url.

include_identity.description: Default true: also read the MCP server card, AI Catalog and ARD manifest and compare what they state.

jwks.description: A JWK Set you already hold for this provider (section 8.4.3 lets a client use keys it keeps itself), up to 20 public keys. Used only when the signature's jku gives no key; results that used it are labelled caller_supplied. Private keys are refused.

url.description: A specific Agent Card URL, for cards hosted away from the well-known path. A bare origin (no path) is treated like domain. The identity files are read from this URL's origin.

name: agent_card_check
